title: MA51119: Multivariate Analysis
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: Probability and StatisticsMultiple linear regression, problems of
multicollinearity, heteroscedasticity and their remedies, autocorrelation and
its remedial measures, polynomial regression and the method of orthogonal
polynomials, nonlinear regression - some specific models and solutions. Testing
general linear hypothesis - testing equality of means of several normal
distributions with common covariance matrix, MANOVA, testing independence of a
set of variates, testing hypotheses of equality of covariance matrices.
Confounding in factorial experiments, fractional replications, split-plot
designs. BIBD and PBIBD. Factor analysis
